repairs.reason: 釗 = Zhao; both occurrences fixed. Relationships unchanged. 毀丸都而歸 records a distinct event: Huang, the subject of the whole sentence, returned after destroying Wandu. The paired literal keeps it ('destroyed Wandu and returned'), but no clause in the idiomatic field conveys it. Adding 'and returned' with Huang as the shared subject restores the omitted event. It keeps the approved Zhao spelling and every other event (digging the tomb, carrying off the corpse, mother, wife and treasures, plundering 50,000+, burning the palaces, razing Wandu) unchanged. This supersedes my earlier style-level note on this omission. No other prior decision changes.

repairs.sourceQuote: 其後廆更寫前箋，並齎其東夷校尉封抽、行遼東相韓矯等三十餘人疏上侃府曰：
repairs.reason: In 並齎…等三十餘人疏, 齎 means Hui also sent along the memorial (疏) of Feng Chou, Han Jiao and the others. 等三十餘人 is the total of signers, more than thirty including the named men, not thirty more besides them. The memorial belongs to those officers, not to Hui jointly, and nothing says they travelled. The proposal made Hui co-author and added 'more than thirty others'.
